primary_endpoint: Participants with sustained ALT reduction to ≤50% of baseline or <40 IU/L at baseline and 96 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 96 weeks, endpoint reached by 9 participants on metformin, 15 on vitamin E, and 10 on placebo; p=0.26 for metformin and p=0.83 for vitamin E (Mantel-Haenszel).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: metformin 7/57, vitamin E 6/58, placebo 14/58; deaths not reported.
